findings.issue: The spec puts the Status values comment on the Result.ID/Status field line ('ID, Status string // Status: completed | partial | reconciliation_required'). The implementation moved it into the type doc comment. The plan instructions allow this and it has no effect on the API.
findings.fix: Optional: also keep the trailing field comment so the code reads verbatim against the spec.

findings.issue: The plan did not ask for the three new *_test.go files (changeset, recipe, sectiontext). They are inside owned paths and only check stub behaviour (not-implemented errors, recipe.New nil error, Sections nil). That is harmless, but lanes L1 to L3 will have to delete or rewrite them when they replace the stubs.
findings.fix: None needed. Lanes should treat these tests as stub-only and replace them.

findings.issue: Stub methods carry no-op discard lines such as `_, _, _ = ctx, actor, items`. Go permits unused parameters, so these lines are dead code. The same pattern appears in internal/recipe/service.go and internal/sectiontext/service.go. The `_ = env` in New was required by the task instructions; the per-method discards were not.
findings.fix: Drop the discard lines in the stub methods, or name the parameters `_`. Lanes replace these bodies anyway.
